title: TreeWalker: Partial Evaluation for Grouped Tree-Ensemble Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.03939v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Many prediction tasks evaluate a trained tree ensemble on groups of rows that share feature values: discrete-time survival models expand each patient into $G$ time steps, click-through-rate models score every item in a search session, and scenario analyses vary a few inputs while holding the rest fixed. Standard inference treats each row independently and ignores this input-side correlation.   We present TreeWalker, which instantiates partial evaluation for grouped tree-ensemble inference: constant features are static, varying features dynamic. TreeWalker walks each tree once per group, partitions a row bitmask at varying splits, and skips empty subtrees via an unsplit shortcut. It reads standard LightGBM and XGBoost models; training is unchanged.   We prove a structural work decomposition: per-tree work splits into the constant-projected subtree size $|T_c|$, $G$ leaf writes, and a predicate-mask provisioning cost $Q$. For the trace

translated_title: TreeWalker：面向分组树集成推理的部分求值方法
translated_abstract: 许多预测任务需要在共享特征值的行组上评估训练好的树集成模型：离散时间生存模型将每位患者扩展为 G 个时间步，点击率模型对搜索会话中的每个物品进行打分，情景分析则在固定其余输入的同时仅改变少数几个输入。标准的推理方式将每一行独立处理，忽略了这种输入侧的相关性。我们提出 TreeWalker，它为分组树集成推理实例化了部分求值思想：恒定特征为静态，变化特征为动态。TreeWalker 对每个组仅遍历每棵树一次，在变化分裂处对行位掩码进行划分，并通过无分裂捷径跳过空的子树。它可直接读取标准的 LightGBM 和 XGBoost 模型，训练过程无需任何改动。我们证明了一个结构化的工作量分解定理：每棵树的工作量可拆分为常数投影子树大小 |T_c|、G 次叶子写入，以及谓词掩码供给成本 Q。对于该轨迹（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: TreeWalker 提出针对分组树集成推理的部分求值方法，利用组内行共享特征值的相关性，对每组仅遍历每棵树一次即可完成推理，并给出了每棵树工作量的结构化分解，同时兼容标准 LightGBM 和 XGBoost 模型。
